---
title: "iSRL Receives Nagarathna Memorial Grant 2026"
date: "2026-04-22"
categories: [Announcement, Grant]
description: "We are grateful to receive the Nagarathna Memorial Grant for our work on the Indian Food ID (IFID)."
---


**iSRL has been selected as a recipient of the Nagarathna Memorial Grant 2026**, a micro-grant programme organised by Thejesh GN and supported by the FOSS United Foundation.

The grant supports iSRL's ongoing work on the **Indian Food Informatics Data (IFID)** project — a deterministic ingredient identity substrate for India's packaged food ecosystem, grounded in FSSAI regulations, ITC-HS nomenclature, and Indian judicial reasoning. IFID is published under CC BY 4.0 as an open research commons, designed to be freely used, extended, and built upon.

We are sincerely grateful to **Thejesh GN** for organising this micro-grant programme and to the **FOSS United Foundation** for their significant support. The Nagarathna Memorial Grant recognises work at the intersection of public data infrastructure and open-source values — a space iSRL is committed to building in.

[Read more about the 2026 grant results.](https://thejeshgn.com/2026/04/22/nagarathna-memorial-grant-2026-results/)
